Legacy Alt codes 0–255

Compare the OEM code page 437 and Windows-1252 tables for every legacy Windows Alt code.

Three-digit Alt codes use the OEM code page 437 table. Four-digit codes with a leading zero use the Windows-1252 table. Both exist, which is why one symbol can have two codes.

About this table

Three-digit codes use the OEM code page 437 table. Four-digit codes with a leading zero use the Windows-1252 table. The two agree below 128 and diverge above 127. Codes 1–31 and 127 have no printable Unicode character; they draw a picture only in an OEM console font.
